during-the-fremennik-isles-operative-bud.prompt: What do you want to say?

steps.player: Hello.

steps.npc: Hello.

steps.player: Not very talkative are you?

steps.npc: Nope.

steps.player: I'll be off then.

steps.npc: Yup.

options.text: The blue fish leap northwards at dawn.

steps.player: The blue fish leap northwards at dawn..

steps.npc: Oranges are not the only fruit.

steps.player: The cabbages bloom in the spring.

steps.npc: My cows produce milk in the evening.

steps.player: I bought an aardvark from Ardougne market.

steps.npc: Yellow balloons are heavier in boxes.

steps.player: ...err...sprockets wangle burps in the forked flan.

steps.npc: You have no idea what you are talking about do you?

steps.player: No, not really.

options.text: It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.

steps.player: It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.
Free stuff please.

steps.npc: Ah, Operative Budgie. Welcome to the island.

steps.player: Budgie? That's not my name, you can call me-

steps.npc: Shh!
No names! Names are unnecessary. Loose lives cost tongues.

steps.player: Shouldn't that be...never mind. So Mr Hemli-

steps.npc: Shhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

steps.player: Sorry, no names. I forgot.

steps.npc: Call me Operative Nighthawk.

steps.player: How come you get the cool name, and I get called Budgie? Can't I be called Operative Panther? Yeah I like that, panthers are cool. Rarrrr!

steps.npc: This is not a democracy, Operative! Panther already exists and he's working on a mission in Al Kharid. It's my way or the highway.

steps.player: Fine, whatever, I don't care anyway.

steps.npc: To business. Here are the details of your operation. You will infiltrate Burgher Burowgar's hall, deep undercover as a travelling entertainer. Burgher Burowgar and his men are known to relax in the
presence of a jester - and a few barrels of beer. To get the information required from the court of Burgher Burowgar you must entertain him.
While you are obeying the Burgher's instructions you should listen in on the conversations of his council and make note of what they discuss.
When you return I shall ask you a few questions about what you have learned.

steps.player: Very well.

steps.npc: You must wear all four pieces of the jester costume without anything in your hands, as the Burgher's guards will search you thoroughly.
Are you ready to begin?

steps.player: I am ready.

steps.text: If the player isn't wearing jester costume or is wielding something

steps.npc: Not dressed like that you're not! You'd better get the rest of your kit, or empty your hands if you have anything in them.

options.text: I just need to visit the bank.

steps.player: I just need to visit the bank.

steps.npc: Hurry back; we must know what Neitiznot's ruler is planning.

steps.player: I shall return soon.
Colourless green ideas sleep furiously.

during-the-fremennik-isles-before-perfor.npc: Have you infiltrated the Burgher's leisure quarters?

during-the-fremennik-isles-before-perfor.player: Not yet. I'll do that now.

standard-dialogue.npc: Shhh. Go away. I'm not allowed to talk to you.
